<!DOCTYPE html><style>body{margin:8px;font:16px/20px Arial}#o,#d,#s,#r{display:block;width:300px}a,button,label,summary,select,span,div,input{margin:0}</style><label id="o" for="cb"><input id="i" type="text"></label><input id="cb" type="checkbox"><script>
if (!location.search) window.name = '';
function L(s) { window.name += (window.name ? '|' : '') + s; }
function mk(tag, attrs, kids) {
  var e = document.createElement(tag);
  for (var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k] === true ? '' : attrs[k]);
  kids.forEach(function (c) { e.append(c); });
  return e;
}
function R() {
  var s = window.name + ' h=' + history.length + ' loc=' + location.search + location.hash;
  document.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox],input[type=radio]').forEach(function (x) { s += ' ' + (x.id || x.name) + '=' + x.checked; });
  document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(function (x) { s += ' ' + x.id + '.open=' + x.open; });
  return s;
}
function watch() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { L('c@' + el.id + (e.defaultPrevented ? '!' : '')); });
  });
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { L('submit@' + e.target.id + '/' + (e.submitter ? e.submitter.id : '-')); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('reset', function (e) { L('reset@' + e.target.id); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) { L('change@' + e.target.id); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('toggle', function (e) { L('toggle@' + e.target.id); }, true);
}
watch();</script>

<!DOCTYPE html><style>body{margin:8px;font:16px/20px Arial}#o,#d,#s,#r{display:block;width:300px}a,button,label,summary,select,span,div,input{margin:0}</style><form id=f action=#S><button id=b><input id=i type=file></button></form><script>
if (!location.search) window.name = '';
function L(s) { window.name += (window.name ? '|' : '') + s; }
function mk(tag, attrs, kids) {
  var e = document.createElement(tag);
  for (var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k] === true ? '' : attrs[k]);
  kids.forEach(function (c) { e.append(c); });
  return e;
}
function R() {
  var s = window.name + ' h=' + history.length + ' loc=' + location.search + location.hash;
  document.querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox],input[type=radio]').forEach(function (x) { s += ' ' + (x.id || x.name) + '=' + x.checked; });
  document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(function (x) { s += ' ' + x.id + '.open=' + x.open; });
  return s;
}
function watch() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[id]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) { L('c@' + el.id + (e.defaultPrevented ? '!' : '')); });
  });
  document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) { L('submit@' + e.target.id + '/' + (e.submitter ? e.submitter.id : '-')); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('reset', function (e) { L('reset@' + e.target.id); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', function (e) { L('change@' + e.target.id); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('toggle', function (e) { L('toggle@' + e.target.id); }, true);
}
watch();</script>
